mechanism: Bumetanide-induced volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities may potentiate sumatriptan's vasoconstrictive effects and increase risk of vascular events; sumatriptan can cause vasoconstriction that may compromise renal perfusion in volume-depleted patients.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and electrolytes; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative migraine therapy if loop diuretic use is necessary.
